Results.ReviewText: I have jumped right in with my Weber Spirit II-310. Gone 10 out of 14 nights. Have grilled, steaks, ckn thighs, breasts, burgers, dogs, brats, veggies, split whole turkey, chateau brianne. Gets hot quickly, a nice zone of consistent heat in the center, but temp drops significantly around the edges.  A little tricky to get or maintain temps at 225 or 325, but with some attention and cycling on/off I have good results with the filet roast (at 225) The turkey at 325 F was a little trickier. Love the flip able grates to allow narrow or wide marks. It is a solid unit for the price, craftsmanship and material quality seem solid. I would buy it again.
Results.Title: Satisfied customer!
